abstract: BACKGROUND: Chylous ascites as a postoperative complication of gynecologic surgery is uncommon. Cases usually occur from trauma to the lymphatic system during retroperitoneal dissection. Initial management includes paracentesis with institution of a low-fat, medium-chain triglyceride diet and total parenteral nutrition (TPN). Surgical intervention may be required. CASE: A 19-year-old female patient with a history of an immature teratoma treated with chemotherapy presented with a retroperitoneal mass. Removal of the mass revealed mature teratoma and resulted in chylous ascites formation. Multiple paracenteses were performed in conjunction with dietary modification and TPN. Three months after the patient's surgery, the ascites spontaneously resolved. CONCLUSION: Although surgical intervention is recommended after failure of conservative management, this case demonstrates that damage to the cisterna chyli may spontaneously resolve.
abstract_ja: 背景：婦人科手術後の乳糜腹水は一般的ではない。通常、後腹膜の剥離中にリンパ系が損傷して発生する。初期管理には、穿刺排液、低脂肪・中鎖トリグリセリド食、完全静脈栄養（TPN）が含まれる。外科的介入が必要となる場合もある。症例：未熟奇形腫の既往があり化学療法を受けた19歳女性が、後腹膜腫瘤で受診した。腫瘤を摘出したところ成熟奇形腫が判明し、乳糜腹水が生じた。複数回の穿刺排液、食事療法、TPNを併用した。術後3か月で腹水は自然に消失した。結論：保存的治療の失敗後には外科的介入が推奨されるが、本症例は乳糜槽の損傷が自然に治癒しうることを示している。
